sellThenNews.title: WSB 情绪分析
sellThenNews.description: r/wallstreetbets 2026 年 7 月 1 日情绪分析。讨论最多的股票代码：MU、MSFT、NVDA、HOOD、META。人工智能生成的零售流程、牛市/熊市叙述和关键主题的摘要。

sections.overview:
1. 整体市场概况和情绪

今日主要事件：

  • Meta announced the formation of a cloud business to sell “excess AI compute” externally (Bloomberg), becoming the absolute main theme of the session. META was up +9.65% intraday to 617.87 (as of 11:50 ET, intraday high 628), following SpaceX’s model of monetizing idle compute and directly entering the home turf of AWS/Azure/Google Cloud. Market interpretation was split: one camp argued that “idle compute = capex inflection point / demand peaking,” while the other believed “high margins, Meta was compute-constrained anyway, and this turns cash burn into profit.”
  • Compute/memory/neocloud were massacred: NBIS -13.9%(238), CRWV -13.2%(86), GLW (Corning) -13.5%(221), KLAC -10.1%, SNDK -9.5%(2055), MU -8.7%(1052, losing 1050 intraday), AMAT -8.2%, LRCX -8.6%, INTC -7.5%, MRVL -7.5%, TSM -6.1%, AMD -5.1%, SOXL -15.1%, NVDA -1.6%(197, failed to hold 200). Yesterday’s big winners were cut in half today.
  • Capital rotated into MAG7 (excluding NVDA) and software/fintech: MSFT +3.1%(384, the SaaS king makes a comeback), APP +10.8%(571), PLTR +8.9%(127), RDDT +9.6%(190, approaching 200), HOOD +7.3%(108), MSTR +11%(with BTC), IBM +3.7%(massive 300 strike 7/17 call flow), AAPL +2.1%(295, multi-day gamma squeeze), TSLA +2.1%(429).
  • Warsh’s (Fed Chair) first global speech leaned hawkish: He reiterated that “inflation is too high and price stability must be delivered,” rejected forward guidance, and the market viewed him as tougher than expected; after the speech, indices ranged but did not sell off sharply, while VIX remained extremely suppressed.
  • Iran-Qatar peace talks hit a snag: Iran said its delegation would not meet with the U.S. side, while oil prices fell about 1.5% intraday; the community turned “peace talks going smoothly → oil prices fall” into a running joke.
  • Index divergence: SPY +0.24%(748, V-shaped rebound from intraday low 742, repeatedly testing 747-750 without breaking through), QQQ -0.92%(729, dragged down by semiconductors), DIA +0.57%, IWM +0.46% (another new-high narrative amid small caps/value closing green in 14/15 months).

社区氛围：整体基调是“混乱中破碎的繁荣”——大盘一片绿，半导体/存储器正在流失，同样的人们在庆祝MSFT/META，同时却被MU/SNDK/NBIS一再打压。人们的情绪在“轮换是正常的，独立日一定会带来 ATH”的乐观信念和“Meta 亲自刺破人工智能泡沫”的恐惧之间迅速摇摆。

恐惧/贪婪：总体上倾向于贪婪。 VIX多次被嘲笑“自满到个位数”，0DTE盈利截图充斥信息流，“第250个独立日必须创下ATH”成为集体信念；然而，半导体持有者陷入了深深的恐慌，人们普遍担心“KOSPI熔断”和“今晚韩国啊”。

情绪与现实：社区对大盘的极端看涨情绪与 SPY 略高和 QQQ 略低的现实背道而驰——真正的指数支撑来自五个 MAG7 名称，而不是“广泛的反弹”。许多零售观察名单“要么持平，要么略显绿色，但不知何故全是红色”，导致人们抱怨“资金只是在不同行业之间急速循环，指数是假绿色。”

股票行情指示器提及牛/熊情绪核心视图摘要
